verdict.rationale: Penpot's own marketing says it supports responsive, rules-based interfaces built with CSS Grid and Flex layouts, which covers the auto-layout and grid parts of the story. That claim rests on a single homepage line, with no user-guide detail on how frames resize and no mention of constraints. Missing for 10: documentation of constraints (pin/scale behavior), in-depth user-guide docs on Flex/Grid layout and frame resizing behavior, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, frames can behave responsively — auto layout, constraints, and grids resize designs the way real UIs flex

citations.quote: Design responsive and rules-based interfaces with wireframes, interactive prototypes, and CSS Grid and Flex layouts.
